summary: Proof confirms a real missing exact Action→canonical product Guidance identity seam. The bounded solution is deterministic StandardActionId-aligned resolution under skills/actions/**, exact content-bound GuidanceRef frozen into ActionPackage, a dedicated ActionPackage validator/projection that leaves durable RunContext unchanged, and reuse of existing ActionPackageRef→ApplicableCheck executionInputRef identity. Stable Core development of flowkit-next itself must remain on the independent .agents/skills bootstrap plane through first stable-release acceptance; D03/D04 must not self-host on the in-development product Guidance.
reviewFocus: Confirm the strict dual-plane boundary: .agents/skills remains the independent flowkit-next Author/Reviewer bootstrap through Stable Core v1, while skills/actions/** is the product-side Flowkit-managed Guidance contract. Also confirm Change 1 remains fail-closed and does not import Changes 2/3 migration, self-hosting convergence, Registry/Router/Runtime, or a second identity system.

Changes 2/3 remain responsible for actual Author/Reviewer canonical Guidance body convergence; Change 1 must not migrate them.
